title: NBA Sim LineupPackage (foundation 0.1.0)
description: Validates the shape of a LineupPackage: the five on-court jerseys for one team plus that unit's usageProfile (priority-ordered creator / screener / spacer lists). Used by config/demo-game.json in T10 to define starters and bench units per team. Frozen alongside docs/foundation/identity-roles.md (T7).

id.description: LineupPackage identifier, e.g. 'starters', 'bench_unit'. Referenced by possession/start events when a package becomes active.

players.description: The five jerseys on court for this package. Exactly five unique jersey strings; order has no semantics.

creator.description: Priority-ordered creator jerseys. Index 0 binds primary_creator for the play; index 1 (if present) binds secondary_creator when the play declares that slot.

screener.description: Priority-ordered screener jerseys. Index 0 binds the 'screener' slot. Empty array is legal for packages with no designated screener (e.g. an iso-heavy unit).

spacer.description: Priority-ordered spacer jerseys. First eligible binds spacer_strong; next binds spacer_weak.

usageProfile.description: Role priority lists consumed by bindRoles(package, play) at possession start.

jersey.description: Jersey string. The only logic-driving identity for a player on court within a game. Alphanumeric only (e.g. '23', '7A'); no separators so the value can appear unquoted-friendly in payloads and event logs.

$comment: Cross-array subset rule (every jersey appearing in usageProfile.creator/screener/spacer MUST also appear in players) cannot be expressed portably in JSON Schema draft-07 without ajv-specific keywords; it is enforced by scripts/check-foundation.mjs (todo 9). Same-package disjunction across creator/screener/spacer is NOT required: a jersey may legitimately appear in two lists (e.g. a creator who also doubles as a spacer).
